reuse.why: Calls the existing getScheduledAmount only for the range branch, while every site keeps its own missing/number/range dispatch that the helper already decides in full, and schedule-template.ts is not routed through it at all.

duplication.why: The null ? 0 : number ? value : range dispatch stays copied at four sites, and schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint formula.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts where it belongs, but new imports are added as second import statements from '#shared/schedules' next to the existing ones.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule, its call sites' comments and a test.

maintainability.why: The rule now lives in the helper plus wrapper dispatches at four sites, and the budget template still plans the midpoint, so ranged schedules are budgeted differently from how they post and forecast.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/schedule-template.ts still computes Math.round(num1 + num2) / 2 itself; the other sites wrap getScheduledAmount in their own null/number dispatch.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining dispatch copies are left in plain view rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts holds the new rule, but server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList still applies the midpoint rule independently.
